selectionDefinition.connection: successive distinct observed possession owners with continuously recorded ball XY; same-team labels are source-consistent
selectionDefinition.claims: tracking-derived geometric descriptions only; no pass, goal, optimal-choice, body, foot, scan, or ball-height event is inferred

themeThresholds.forwardConnection: at least 9 m in established attack direction
themeThresholds.pressureSupport: nearest observed opposing player at the ownership anchor is at most 6 m away and the connection is less than 10 m forward; no approach or closing speed is inferred
themeThresholds.carryThenConnect: possession owner moves at least 3.5 m while continuously tagged
themeThresholds.wideToInside: starts at least 20 m wide and gains at least 6 m inside
themeThresholds.combination: three observed same-team owners, each within 8 s
themeThresholds.turnover: next observed owner belongs to the opposing source-labelled team
themeThresholds.recovery: original team has a familiar observed owner within 10 s of a turnover
